description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the NodeProject class in the Goteo application, testing creation, validation, removal, and exception handling.

classes.name: NodeProjectTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing NodeProject functionality in the Goteo application.

methods.name: testInstance
